changes: Require all query terms instead of silent partial suggestions
Rank page titles, chapter headings, then body matches
Deduplicate chapter destinations and retain page-only results
Validate HTTP status and data shape before building indexes
Build indexes in cooperatively scheduled chapter-sized batches to keep the dialog responsive
Preserve native Home/End text editing in the input
Show loading and connection failure separately from no results
Clear stale options while a query is pending and reject stale completions
Normalize query highlighting and bound input length
Deactivate stale options immediately when the input is cleared
Highlight each normalized query term independently
Mark the 404 page noindex while retaining the shared head, theme, navigation and search assets
Include the shared canonical blog and learning path in both language search indexes
Retain language-specific pages, exclusion rules and glossary handling

maintenance: When upgrading the theme, compare these overrides with their upstream versions and rerun site assets, image fixtures, the search unit test and the full browser regressions.
scope: Upstream-derived overrides introduced in the 2026-10-27 review; earlier repository overrides remain documented in their original reviews.
